name: cosend
description: Cosend runs your business's WhatsApp from Grok Build over MCP: a shared WhatsApp inbox on the number you already use, WhatsApp campaigns to saved audiences, WhatsApp templates submitted for Meta's review, WhatsApp automation built from a plain description, and an AI receptionist trained on your website and files. Every message, campaign and template submission, and every automation deploy and switch-on, comes to you as a preview you approve. New automations are saved switched off. Sign in with your Cosend account on first connect.
